summary: Feed s086_single is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10, 20 are completely missing. All other checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, encryption) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/mirror is stripping 802.1Q tags before delivery - trunk not configured to preserve VLANs or broker is set to strip tags on egress to the SIEM. Result is 100% untagged traffic despite VLANs 10 and 20 being required.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM loses VLAN context for VLANs 10 and 20; cannot filter, correlate, or apply VLAN-based detection/content rules. Detection coverage for those segments is effectively blind even though SIEM does not need bidirectional or full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 on the broker egress/SPAN trunk so SIEM receives correctly tagged traffic and can restore detection coverage.
